experiment: neural-v3 retrospective arena paint and timing clues
scope: Read-only reanalysis of the already selected40 arena replays. No new games, strategy changes, training changes, Java runs or strength measurements.

definitions.turns: Zero-based CgPlayerStudy trace turns. Early window is0<=turn<20, fixed for all40 games.
definitions.acceptedPaint: Rules.resolve PlayerMoves.cost from recorded commands; acceptedCells is PlayerMoves.count. Opponent comparisons use same board/turn.
definitions.nominalCapacity: 3 paint per player per turn. It is an upper bound; this analysis does not reconstruct whether enough eligible/affordable construction remained.
definitions.heightGroups: Retrospective descriptive split14..17 versus18..20 motivated by observed size trend, not a preregistered significance test.
definitions.wholeGameVsEarly: Whole-game totals can conceal early under-spending because opponents later stop building.
definitions.warnings: Exact own stderr WARN turn N took Xms from CGRunner; linked by explicit N, never by frame index because stderr may arrive in a later frame.
definitions.executionTimeMs: Raw per-game metadata values retained verbatim. Cached official Game.java logExecutionTime sums Player.getLastExectionTimeMs across turns and emits that sum. No per-turn/phase CPU timeline is inferred; units/clock are not equated to local System.nanoTime or viewer animation times.

runtimeEvidence.serverFailureInterpretation: No recorded server timeout/failure in this sample. Local self-reported WARN51ms is not relabelled as an official timeout.

runtimeCodeMechanisms.behavior: Incomplete initial preparation or sabotage pass returns WAIT and records target=-1, before any placement.

Build preparation/features/scoring cutoff discards only unfinished next placement; earlier placements and chosen disruption survive. Before later placements, leftMs<6 also stops without setting lastAbortedPhase.
Chosen cell is committed only after a complete score pass: place cost, scratch ownership, markPlaced, core connection update, then action append.
Feature scan has cooperative checks and atomic core updateConnections calls; candidate set can also be empty because of affordability/locality/ink rules.

Later wrapper budget is50-14=36ms minus parsing/setup already spent; V3 reserves another2ms. First turn additionally allows500ms warmup and a much larger total budget. WARN measures local wall time for the wrapper turn.
DEBUG abort field prints only through the normal return path; early abortTurn returns before that log. DEBUG evidence is absent from these raw replays.

limitations: Accepted-paint shortfall alone does not prove a missed legal move or a timer abort; eligible candidate counts and exact abort phases were not logged.
84 own wall-time warnings,79 with short paint, strengthen the runtime-pressure hypothesis but do not establish how much arena strength it costs.
Per-game executionTimeMs does not localize short turns; do not subtract a guessed first-turn cost or use viewer event duration as CPU time.
Height correlates with other map properties and opponents;2/11 wins on larger maps is descriptive, not a causal map-size estimate.
This fixed latest40 sample is not a matched comparison against v09 or an unbiased arena-rating sample.
Current neural-v4 temperature experiment and every frozen policy remain unchanged.
